transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer billing, my name is Craig. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Craig. I am furious about my final bill. I moved house last month to a remote cottage where S-Net has no broadband network, and your agent told me I wouldn't be penalized. But today I opened my final bill and you have slapped me with an early termination fee of two hundred and twenty pounds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can inspect the final account statement, George, but first let's complete security verification. What is your full name and previous account address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: George Henderson, formerly 14 Highfield Avenue, Newcastle, NE2 3TJ.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the security PIN on the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What was the date of your home move and your new postal address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We moved on September fifteenth to Croft Cottage, Kielder, Northumberland, NE48 1AX.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did you submit an official Home Move request through our website before moving?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, reference HM-77192, and the move agent told me that because S-Net cannot provide service in Kielder, the contract would be terminated without any early exit fees.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our automated billing engine generates early termination fees on any account that ceases before the minimum term, so that's handled by automated debt batching, not our department.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't care if it's automated! You took two hundred and twenty pounds from my bank account when your own company policy states moves to non-serviceable areas are fee-free!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well, if you choose to move to the middle of nowhere, you have to expect billing complications.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Excuse me? Moving for my job is none of your business, Craig! That is an outrageous comment to make to a customer!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: As I said, the automated billing engine applies early termination charges if the non-serviceable exception flag is left unchecked by the move agent.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then check the flag and refund my money! I want my two hundred and twenty pounds back!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check where you moved to again. What was that new postcode in Northumberland?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is NE48 1AX, as I told you at the start.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me while I verify the broadband network availability at NE48 1AX on our wholesale line database.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, George. I have checked the Openreach and S-Net fibre footprint for NE48 1AX.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And what does the coverage checker show?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It confirms there is zero S-Net or Openreach FTTP or FTTC infrastructure at that address, only satellite or 4G.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Exactly! Which qualifies me for fee-free contract cancellation under your terms of service!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, under section 8.4 of our terms, moving to an unserviceable UK postal address waives all remaining contract liability.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And did you return the S-Net Hub router using the prepaid returns satchel from your previous property?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I dropped the prepaid box at the Jesmond post office on September tenth before we left Newcastle.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the warehouse intake barcode on the return satchel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the Hub 4 router barcode was scanned at our logistics depot on September twelfth, so the equipment record is clear.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good, I made sure not to pack the router into the removal van by accident.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That avoided any non-return equipment charges being added to the final account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Glad I remembered to post it before the move day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you don't have any mobile SIMs or secondary TV pucks linked to that former billing profile?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, just the single standalone broadband line in Newcastle.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That ensures the account ledger is fully closed and will not generate any trailing charges.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Excellent, clean break.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you waive that two hundred and twenty pound charge right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am applying an early termination fee waiver credit of two hundred and twenty pounds to your final statement ledger right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And how do I get that money refunded to my current account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because the direct debit collected the funds last Friday, I will trigger an electronic BACS refund directly back to your bank account ending in 9921.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long will that BACS refund take to clear into my bank?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The electronic bank credit takes two to three working days to show in your cleared balance.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you send me a revised final statement showing the cancellation of that fee?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I am generating an updated final invoice showing zero balance and two hundred and twenty pounds refund pending.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Emailing it to me now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Dispatched to your email on file, george dot henderson at fastmail dot co dot uk.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me refresh my email on my phone.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Got it! 'S-Net Revised Final Statement - Balance: £0.00. Refund Approved: £220.00'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm for our audit ledger, your former billing address was 14 Highfield Avenue, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 14 Highfield Avenue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you confirm the direct debit instruction will remain open until the BACS refund processes on Friday?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I won't cancel the bank mandate until the refund clears.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your contact mobile number, it is 07700 900591, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my mobile number.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your closed account or final billing that I can help with today, George?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Craig, as long as that refund hits my account on Friday, that completely resolves it. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net in the past, George, and all the best with your new home.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, goodbye.
